basic_details.job_title: CRC Kozhikode Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 DEO, Occupational Therapist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Composite Regional Centre for Skill Development, Rehabilitation & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (CRC Kozhikode) has invited applications from eligible Indian Nationals for 9 contractual consultant positions at its Cross Disability Early Intervention Centre (CDEIC), Kozhikode. Applications go by post, in the prescribed format, to the Director, CRC Kozhikode, and must reach the office within 21 days of the advertisement's publication in the Employment News. The notice prints no calendar date for the last day.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid as a non-refundable Demand Draft drawn on any Nationalized Bank in favour of Director, CRC Kozhikode, and submitted with the application. No other mode of payment is accepted. If notified vacancies are cancelled, the fee paid is not refunded.

content_sections.heading: About CRC Kozhikode
content_sections.text: CRC Kozhikode is located at Golf Link Road, Chevayur PO, Kozhikode, Kerala – 673 017. It works under the administrative control of NIEPMD, Chennai, and under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India. The posts are in its Cross Disability Early Intervention Centre (CDEIC).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled-in application in the prescribed format so that it reaches: Director, CRC Kozhikode, Golf Link Road, Chevayur P.O., Kozhikode, Kerala – 673017. Applicants for more than one discipline or post must submit a separate application form for each, with proof of the requisite fee. Late, incomplete or not-in-format applications, and those not mentioning the post with Sl. No. and "contractual", will not be considered. For queries, the notice gives the email id [email protected] ; applications are not sent there.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. The maximum age limit is 56 years for all positions except Sl. No. 10, reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation and no minimum age. M.Phil./MA in Clinical Psychology/Rehabilitation Psychology/Psychology or equivalent qualification recognized by RCI. Minimum 02 years relevant post-qualification experience. BOT or higher. Minimum 02 years relevant post-qualification experience. BASLP or higher. B.Ed. Special Education (MD / LD / ASD / HI / VI). Minimum 02 years relevant post-qualification experience. Desirable: preference for cross disability experience. Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT). Minimum 02 years relevant post qualification experience. Divyang Mitra with RCI certified CBID / CCCG / CCCG-P certificate or equivalent. 2 vacancies. Graduate with knowledge of computer. Medical Doctors: MBBS with PG Degree/PG Diploma in the requisite specialization or equivalent. Genetic Counsellor: Master's degree in Genetic Counselling/Medical Genetics or equivalent. Optometrist: Bachelor of Optometry (B.Optom)/Doctor of Optometry or equivalent. Nutritionist/Dietitian: M.Sc. in Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Clinical Nutrition or B.Sc. Dietetics with relevant registration / certification, as applicable. Number: 01 each. A total of at most 15 visits a month, with at least 4 hours per visit. Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to be considered eligible. content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid as a non-refundable Demand Draft drawn on any Nationalized Bank in favour of Director, CRC Kozhikode, and submitted with the application. No other mode of payment is accepted. If notified vacancies are cancelled, the fee paid is not refunded.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The final list of candidates called for interview/written test is based on short-listing by a duly constituted Screening Committee. Only short-listed candidates will be communicated, and no interim correspondence will be entertained. The notice does not describe the interview or test further.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates in support of educational qualifications. Self-attested copies of experience certificates. Caste and disability certificates, where applicable. Copy of valid RCI / council registration, where applicable. Copy of the date of birth certificate (the form says "Enclose Copy of Certificate"). Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- for fee, unless exempted.

content_sections.heading: Service Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary. The term ordinarily does not exceed an initial 3 years and may be extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The incumbent has no right to claim regularization or extension/renewal of engagement in any circumstances. Only consolidated honorarium is paid. DA, HRA, MA, GPF, NPS and other allowances are not admissible. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. An annual increment of 5% is based on one year from date of joining and a satisfactory performance report evaluated by the department. Selected candidates may be posted at CDEIC, CRC Kozhikode and its Sub centres. The competent authority may end the engagement at any time, without giving reasons, on 30 days notice. A person who resigns must give 30 days advance notice or remuneration in lieu.

If an error in selection is found even after an appointment order, the Institute may modify, withdraw or cancel any communication to candidates. CRC Kozhikode keeps application data of non-shortlisted candidates for six months after the offer letter is issued to the selected candidate. Any corrigendum or revision will be posted on the official website of CRC Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in the CRC Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sl. No. 1 to 9 together have 10 vacancies, including 2 for Trained Caregivers. Sl. No. 10, need-based visits of external doctors and allied professionals, is shown as 01 each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for CRC Kozhikode applications?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 21 days from the date of publishing the advertisement in the Employment News. The notice prints no calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Special Educator posts?
faq.answer: One post needs B.Ed. Special Education (ID) and the other B.Ed. Special Education (MD / LD / ASD / HI / VI), each with a minimum of 02 years relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years for all positions except Sl. No. 10, counted as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- as a non-refundable Demand Draft in favour of Director, CRC Kozhikode. SC/ST/PWDs/Female/Transgender candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 60,000 for Clinical/Rehabilitation Psychologist, Rs. 50,000 for Sl. No. 2 to 7, Rs. 30,000 for Trained Caregivers and Rs. 25,000 for Data Entry Operator. Sl. No. 10 is paid Rs. 3750 or Rs. 3000 per visit.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form, attach self-attested certificates and the Demand Draft, and send it so that it reaches the Director, CRC Kozhikode, Golf Link Road, Chevayur P.O., Kozhikode, Kerala – 673017.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee short-lists candidates, and short-listed candidates are called for interview/written test. Only short-listed candidates are communicated.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, ordinarily for an initial period not exceeding 3 years, extendable up to a maximum of 5 years, with no right to regularization.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate applying for more than one discipline or post must submit a separate application form with proof of the requisite fee for each.
